extracted.intended_audience: journalism professionals, news organizations, potential ONA members, and supporters (philanthropy, technology, academia)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational statement of values, strategic pillars, and member expectations from the Online News Association intended to guide journalistic practice, programming, and organizational priorities. Useful for assessing alignment of programs, projects, or newsroom practices with ONA's stated principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Responsible journalism using innovative tools and platforms means the distinction between news and other information must always be clear; the original source for information should be apparent; and efforts made to verify information should be explicit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish news from other information, make original sources apparent, and explicitly present verification efforts. Applies across platforms and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Diversity and inclusion in all journalism roles contributes a variety of perspectives critical for empathetic storytelling, driving innovation and accessing new markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize diversity and inclusion across roles to improve storytelling, innovation, and audience reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalistic Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists should maintain the highest principles of fairness, accuracy, objectivity and responsible independent reporting, as well as in distributing, sourcing, reviewing and corroborating information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uphold fairness, accuracy, objectivity, and responsibility in reporting, distribution, sourcing, review, and corroboration practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: As journalists strive for the highest quality storytelling — no matter the medium — they should be strategic in their use of reporting tools, design techniques and distribution platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pursue high-quality storytelling across media and be strategic in choosing reporting tools, design approaches, and distribution methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists should foster a vibrant, respectful, and supportive environment for the communities they serve, and for one another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate respectful, supportive interactions both with audiences/communities served and among journalism professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of Expression
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists must be free to report the news without fear of retribution, detention or personal harm, and will advocate for unfettered access to public information and officials. They will support the public’s right to be informed and to freely express opinions about the news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protect and advocate for journalists' safety, access to public information, and the public's right to information and expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision: journalism that thrives through change
rubrics_metrics.description: A journalism industry that doesn’t just survive change but thrives through it—where continuous learning, strategic collaboration, and adaptive leadership across all roles and functions create an ecosystem powerful enough to meet democracy’s evolving information needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage continuous learning, collaboration, and adaptive leadership so journalism can proactively respond to change and serve democratic needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: equip professionals with adaptive leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: We equip journalism professionals across all roles, functions and career stages with adaptive leadership capabilities, strategic foresight, and collaborative communities and networks, creating a connected ecosystem where shared learning, experimentation and innovation strengthen journalism’s capacity to serve democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design programs and resources that build adaptive leadership, foresight, and collaborative networks to strengthen journalism’s democratic role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Pillar — Industry Intelligence and Foresight
rubrics_metrics.description: We establish ONA as journalism’s essential intelligence hub, combining industry knowledge with outside-in perspective to help journalism professionals anticipate and adapt to change, while creating a comprehensive content ecosystem that reaches changemakers year-round.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide timely industry analysis and outward perspectives to help professionals anticipate change and maintain a year-round content ecosystem for changemakers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Pillar — Connected Communities and Networks
rubrics_metrics.description: We create and nurture high-value gatherings and ongoing connections that break down silos, spark collaboration, and build the relationships essential for industry resilience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize events and ongoing networking that break down silos and foster collaboration and resilience across the industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Pillar — Continuous Learning and Adaptive Leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: We create comprehensive pathways that build emerging technology fluency and adaptive leadership capabilities, meeting journalism professionals where they are in their careers and elevating their capacity to thrive through industry transformation and drive positive change within their organizations and the broader ecosystem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop training pathways that build tech fluency and leadership skills tailored to career stage to enable professionals to lead through transformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Pillar — Organizational and Operational Resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: We build ONA’s financial sustainability and operational resilience by diversifying revenue streams, strengthening member engagement systems, and creating scalable infrastructure that enables sustained impact and growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on sustainable funding, member engagement, and scalable systems to ensure long-term organizational impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: ONA Membership: benefits and role in mission
rubrics_metrics.description: ONA’s members receive exclusive benefits, including discounted registration to conferences, training events, peer support, professional development resources, leadership opportunities and a premier awards program with global reach. Members help sustain ONA’s mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership both provides professional benefits (discounts, training, peer support, leadership, awards) and supports ONA’s capacity to deliver programs aligned with its mission.
